name: Magnum Electronics

about:
Magnum Electronics, Inc., a family-owned communications systems integrator, is headquartered in Dover, Delaware. The company focuses on supporting mission-critical emergency workers in government and enterprise sectors.

Magnum supplies and services public-safety digital two-way radio systems, 4G LTE wireless networks, rugged mobile computers, and GPS fleet management solutions. As a Motorola Solutions Elite Channel Partner and Cradlepoint Premier Partner, the firm designs custom wireless architectures spanning RF, LTE, and WiFi, handles FCC licensing, performs professional installation and vehicle upfitting, and provides factory-certified repair, programming, and bench service. It also offers short- and long-term radio rentals configured on nationwide FCC frequencies, and operates an AI-powered video telematics platform for real-time fleet tracking and driver safety monitoring.

Customers include law enforcement, fire, and EMS agencies, as well as construction and public-works fleets, enterprise campuses, and event organizers requiring temporary communications. The company holds State of Delaware contracts for equipment and installation and is an approved vendor for Delaware SB79 in-building public-safety coverage testing.

Founded on the transition from digital RF voice to IP-based wireless networks, Magnum invested early in LTE training and became a certified Cradlepoint partner in 2014. Its differentiators include manufacturer certifications from Motorola, Ericsson, 3M, Whelen, and Federal Signal, membership in the Enterprise Wireless Alliance, and an archival system that stores every radio configuration by serial number for rapid redeployment.
